title: Ethical Hacking and Capture the Flag

q.q: What is ethical hacking?

Breaking into accounts to look around

q.q: What is penetration testing?

o: A public file telling search engines what not to list

o: It can list "secret" pages the owner wants hidden

o: Stop and tell a teacher or IT immediately
